review.assessment: The change replaces the method stubs with a complete `EventEmitter` implementation using a `Map<string, Listener[]>` to store listeners per event. It correctly handles registration (`on`), removal (`off`), emission (`emit` by iterating over a shallow copy of the listener array to avoid mutation issues during callbacks), and one-time firing (`once` via a wrapper that unregisters itself before invoking the original listener). No defects were identified; the implementation matches the provided stubs, adheres to standard EventEmitter semantics, and passes all recorded acceptance checks.
